THE PEOPLE BEHIND YOUR JOURNEY

Rooted in Tanzania.
Made around you.

Mambeu Safaris is locally owned and based in Arusha, sharing the country we call home through personal wildlife, mountain, cultural and beach journeys.

LOCAL ROOTS. PERSONAL JOURNEYS.
WHO WE ARE

Local knowledge.
Human connections.

Founded by local Tanzanians, Mambeu brings a close connection to Tanzania’s landscapes, wildlife and communities. Our team plans bespoke journeys through the places we know and love.

We welcome different budgets and travel styles. We help choose routes, stays and activities around your comfort, interests and time available.

Responsible tourism is part of our approach: respecting wildlife, supporting local communities and making meaningful connections with the places you visit.

OUR MISSION

Help every traveller
find their Tanzania.

We create personalised travel experiences that showcase Tanzania’s natural beauty and cultural richness, with comfort, safety and local insight.

Our vision is to grow through thoughtful service and responsible tourism, supporting local communities while sharing the country’s extraordinary places.
